summary: Vodafone Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification dated 2 October 2026. Societe Generale disclosed that on 30 September 2026 its total interest fell marginally to 8.995965% from 9.015218%, comprising 2,077,547,634 direct voting rights (8.977018%) plus 4,384,998 rights through cash-settled derivatives (0.018947%, including certificates, contracts for difference, listed and OTC call/put warrants and options). This is a routine disclosure of a passive holding, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for further threshold-crossing filings as derivative positions roll off.
